name: std::integer_sequence

declarations.code:
template <class T, T... Ints>

class integer_sequence;

intro: The class template std::integer_sequence represents a compile-time sequence of integers. When used as an argument to a function template, the parameter pack Ints can be deduced and used in pack expansion.

sections.title: Template parameters
sections.text:
T

 -

 an integer type to use for the elements of the sequence


 ...Ints

 -

 a non-type parameter pack representing the sequence

 (public static member function)

std::integer_sequence::size



 static constexpr std::size_t size() noexcept;
  
  



Returns the number of elements in Ints. Equivalent to sizeof...(Ints).

 Parameters
(none)

 Return value
The number of elements in Ints.
